attributes.name: Drake Rider
attributes.powers:
The Drake Rider is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. On each check to defeat, if you succeed at an Intelligence or Knowledge 12 check, or if the check has the Force or Ranged trait, add 5.

If you fail a check to defeat the Drake Rider, you may reroll the dice; take the new result. If you do, the Drake Rider deals 1d4 Combat damage to you, then deals 1d4 Electricity damage to you.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Drake Rider, change "If you succeed at an Intelligence or Knowledge 12 check, or if your check has the Force or Ranged trait, add 5 to your checks to defeat it" to "On each check to defeat, if you succeed at an Intelligence or Knowledge 12 check, or if the check has the Force or Ranged trait, add 5."
corrections.issue: Only one of my checks to defeat the Drake Rider has the Force or Ranged trait. Do I get to add 5 to the check that doesn't?
